Dzhuryn Jewish Cemetery Pre-War Section

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the pre-war section of Dzhuryn's Jewish cemetery, which divides into two distinct parts — this older section and a separately documented post-war section elsewhere in this collection. Dzhuryn's Jewish community, first settled in 1699 and tied administratively to the Jewish community of nearby Murafa, documented elsewhere in this collection, reached 1,585 people (34 percent of the town) by 1897, with Jewish craftsmen dominant in local sugar refineries and a Jewish medic running small clinics at one of them. This older section, fenced with an authentic masonry wall, holds a few surviving matzevot dating to the first half of the 20th century.
